title: Scheduled NPC and relationship talk proof

architecture_review.rationale: Adds relationship state ownership and an additive save schema version with backward-compatible v1 load.

player_outcome: One named NPC follows a simple daily schedule and the player can talk to them to raise affection, trust, and respect.
acceptance_criteria: A named NPC exists in world state with a stable entity ID.
The NPC presentation follows a schedule keyed by hour of day.
Talking to the NPC advances time and raises affection, trust, and respect.
Relationship state survives save/load through schema version 2.
Schema version 1 saves still load without relationships.
EditMode tests cover schedule resolution, talk results, and relationship save round-trip.
save_impact: schema version 2 additive relationships; v1 remains loadable
